dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 09, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**NATIONALS SHUT DOWN REDS, MANAEA DOMINATES PIRATES**

Abimelec Ortiz led the charge for the Washington Nationals with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI, as the team cruised to a 7-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds. Ortiz's home run was one of the few bright spots for the Reds, who were otherwise shut down by the Nationals' pitching staff. Meanwhile, Sean Manaea threw a dominant 7 innings, striking out 11 and allowing just 1 run in the New York Mets' 11-1 thrashing of the Pittsburgh Pirates. Luis Robert Jr. hit 2 home runs and drove in 4 runs for the Mets, leading the team to their 11th run.

In another game, Kyle Schwarber hit 2 home runs and drove in 4 runs for the Philadelphia Phillies, who edged the Toronto Blue Jays 7-6. Jesús Luzardo pitched 7 strong innings for the Phillies, striking out 12 and allowing just 2 runs.
